answer: Problem: Sybil farms flood attest rings with zero-history clones before stake bites. Mechanism: each identity posts a lantern bond of 0.55 POA that stays dark until it clears a karst of 4 unpaid relay hops on distinct tunnel-ids; each hop emits a 17s signal pulse whose hash differs by at least 11 bits from the prior hop. Cost: 0.55 POA locked 1 epoch plus ~68s wait. Verification: peers recompute tunnel diversity, pulse spacing, and bit-distance in-epoch. Failure: recycled tunnel or early pulse burns 0.18 POA and extinguishes the lantern for 1 epoch.
